goal: Import crawled Fabbi markdown and images into local SQLite .data while preserving strict mock-only behavior when USE_MOCK_DATA=true.
constraints: Do not reintroduce Supabase runtime dependencies or Supabase environment variables.
Do not change admin auth/session behavior.
Do not delete existing files from public/images or .data without explicit approval.
Do not store absolute Windows paths in browser-facing SQLite fields.
Do not redesign public or CMS UI.

qualityGates.redGate: Targeted import tests exist and fail before implementation.
qualityGates.greenGate: Targeted tests, type-check, build, idempotent import, and separate review pass.
qualityGates.visualGate: Required only if public page rendering changes are made.
